asked.item: Does 'Earn 50% on all paid customers' mean 50% of every month a referred Creator customer stays?
Commission on a monthly Creator referral

verdict.reason: The pages directly say the Tolt text is generic and commission applies to the first payment only, with a Creator example.

steps.text: No, the Tolt message "Earn 50% on all paid customers." is generic Tolt text.
Blotato's standard commission applies to the referred customer's first payment only, not every recurring subscription payment.
For a monthly subscription, the first payment is the monthly charge, so for the Creator plan ($97/month) you earn $48.50 after the customer's first payment succeeds.
